dialog.english:
Haaaaaah...
I can't take it anymore!
I can't take another step...
dialog.translation: No puedo dar un paso más...

dialog.english: We've reached our limit.
Okay, let's take a break!
Hmm...It still doesn't work.

Your computer's not working? If
you give it a whack, it'll be
fine!
dialog.translation:
¿Tu ordenador no funciona? ¡Si le
pegas un guantazo seguro
que ya va!

dialog.english: Aaah!! P-Please stop!
Tch! I was trying to fix it.
Whew...I hope it isn't broken.
dialog.translation: Uf... Espero que no esté roto.

dialog.english:
I did it, I fixed it! Huh? Why is
it functioning, even though the
battery's at zero?!
dialog.translation:
¡Ya está! ¡Funciona! ¿Eh? ¡¿Por qué,
si la batería marca cero?!

dialog.english:
Heeeeey! Everyone, get over here!
There's a factory!

There really is...
but what's a factory doing here?
dialog.translation:
Pues sí...
¿Pero qué hace una fábrica aquí?

dialog.english:
What's this? Should we
investigate?
Let's check it out!

(This factory...I wonder if it has
anything to do with my computer
working again.)
dialog.translation:
(Esta fábrica... Me pregunto si
tiene que ver con que mi
ordenador funcione.)

dialog.english:
Heeeeeeey, Izzy! Let's go
check out the factory!
Yes, I'm coming right now!
It's a really big factory.

If there's a factory, there must
be humans here! Time to
investigate!
dialog.translation:
¡Si hay una fábrica, habrá humanos
aquí! ¡Vamos a echar un vistazo!

dialog.english: Indeed.
This door's closed!

Hnnnnf...! I don't think we're
strong enough to open it.
dialog.translation:
¡Hnnff...! No creo que podamos
abrirla a la fuerza.

dialog.english: Please wait a minute.

This kind of door will only open
under certain conditions.
dialog.translation:
Este tipo de puerta sólo abre
bajo ciertas condiciones.

dialog.english: Conditions... What conditions?
Maybe... Something like a switch.

A switch? Like that one right
there?
It definitely looks like a switch.
dialog.translation: Pues sí que parece un interruptor.

dialog.english: Hey, T.K! What's a switch?

When you hit it, there's a "beep"
and something happens!
dialog.translation:
¡Cuando lo pulsas, hace "bip" y
ocurren cosas!

dialog.english:
It’s that kind of thing. So, let’s
go hit the switch.
dialog.translation:
Algo así. Bueno, pulsemos
el interruptor.

dialog.english: It worked!

As I thought, the door reacted to
the switch.
dialog.translation:
Como pensaba, la puerta se abre
así.

dialog.english:
So anytime a door doesn't open, we
should look for a switch, right?
dialog.translation:
De modo que si una puerta no abre
deberíamos buscar un botón, ¿no?

dialog.english:
It's the power of science! There
must be humans here, no doubt
about it!
dialog.translation:
¡El poder de la ciencia! ¡Seguro
que hay humanos aquí, no tengo
dudas!

dialog.english: Hmmm, it's not opening...

It won't work that way. We should
push the switch.
dialog.translation:
No funcionará así. Tenemos
que pulsar el botón.

dialog.english: It isn't opening after all...

Isn't there some kind of spell you
can cast to open a door?
dialog.translation:
¿No habrá algún hechizo para poder
abrir puertas?

dialog.english: Open, sesame! Like that?
That's so unscientific...
It didn't open.
I'm tired of all these mazes!

Don't panic. Just look for the
switch. Every room seems to be
different...
dialog.translation:
Relax, tan sólo busca el botón.
Todas las salas parecen
diferentes...

dialog.english: Hmm, it didn't open.
We might have passed the switch...
Let's keep going for now!

It seems that there's another
door.

There should be another switch
around here somewhere, right?
Let's hurry up and look.
dialog.translation:
Debe haber otro botón por aquí,
¿verdad? Démonos prisa y
busquemos.

dialog.english: It seems there's another door.
We pressed the switch.
The door should open now, but...
So is it open?

It seems there is also a lock in
which one has to push multiple
switches.
dialog.translation:
Parece que algunos cierres
requieren pulsar múltiples
botones.

dialog.english: It's not opening?

That's strange. We even pushed the
switch.
dialog.translation:
Qué raro, si hemos pulsado el
botón.

dialog.english:
Let's keep exploring. I'm sure
we'll find some kind of clue.
dialog.translation:
Sigamos explorando. Seguro que
encontramos alguna pista.

dialog.english: We pressed the switch!
The door should probably open.
Another switch?
I think it'll open a door, but...
dialog.translation: Creo que abrirá la puerta, pero...

dialog.english: We pushed the switch, but...
There's no door for it.

Maybe we'll figure it out if we
just keep going.
dialog.translation:
Quizás lo descubramos si seguimos
adelante.

dialog.english:
We've come rather deep into the
factory, but it seems that we
still have a long way to go.
dialog.translation:
Hemos llegado a lo profundo de la
fábrica, pero aún parece que
queda mucho más.

dialog.english: How about we rest here for now?
Where ya goin'?

I'm interested in something, but
it's probably dangerous to stray
too far from the group.
dialog.translation:
Me interesa algo, pero quizás sea
peligroso apartarse del grupo.

dialog.english: Where ya goin'?

I wanted to take a look at that
passage on the left.
dialog.translation:
Quería ver lo que había en el
lado izquierdo.

dialog.english: Can you watch TV on that computer?
dialog.translation: ¿Puedes ver la tele en esa máquina?

dialog.english:
I don't have a TV tuner, and I
don't know how we'd get a signal.
dialog.translation:
No tiene sintonizador, y no creo
que pudiera coger señal.

dialog.english:
Then it can't do anything! It's
just an annoyance to the rest of
us.
dialog.translation:
¡Pues vaya trasto! Tan solo es
un estorbo para todos.

dialog.english:
This place is bigger than I
thought and it's hard to find
anything. My muscles are all sore.
dialog.translation:
Este lugar es más grande de lo
que pensaba. Es difícil encontrar
nada. Y tengo agujetas.

dialog.english:
Of course they're sore! We've been
walking all this way.
dialog.translation:
¡Claro que tienes! Hemos andado
durante todo el día.

dialog.english:
We got through a jungle, we got
through a desert...

Sora, I'd like to ask everyone
where we should look after this.
dialog.translation:
Sora, me gustaría preguntar a
todos dónde deberíamos buscar.

dialog.english:
Hey, Sora! I see a push cart over
there! Let's play with it!
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, Sora! ¡Veo un carrito allí!
¡Vayamos a jugar con él!

dialog.english: Hold on, Piyomon! Don't pull me!
(It looks tough for you, Sora...)

Izzy! It looks like your
computer started working again!
dialog.translation:
¡Izzy! ¡Parece que tu ordenador ya
funciona de nuevo!

dialog.english: Huh? I wonder why...

Hey, why are you hiding your
computer?
Hahaha...
Waaaaaaait, Patamooooooon!
Ahaha! Okay, you're "it", T.K!

Those two...I wonder if humans and
Digimon become more alike when
they spend time together?
dialog.translation:
Esos dos... Me pregunto si
humanos y Digimon se parecen más
al pasar tiempo juntos.

dialog.english:
Why're ya starin' at me,
Izzy?

Come to think of it...back in
social studies, we took a field
trip to a bread factory.
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo pienso... en clase
de sociales fuimos a una fábrica
de pan.

dialog.english: I went on that trip, too.

We're used to factories with lots
of people working in them, but...
dialog.translation:
Solemos ver fábricas con un
montón de gente dentro, pero...

dialog.english:
This factory really is full of
mysteries.
dialog.translation:
Esta fábrica es todo un
misterio.

dialog.english: We should keep going, but...

There's two doors. Which do we go
through?

This factory is very large. It 
seems more efficient to 
investigate in 2 separate groups.
dialog.translation:
Esta fábrica es enorme. Sería más
eficiente si investigásemos en
dos grupos separados.

dialog.english:
All right, we'll split into teams.
Izzy, pick who you want on
yours.
dialog.translation:
Vale, dividámonos en grupos.
Izzy, selecciona a quién quieres
en el tuyo.

dialog.english: Is it okay for me to choose?

Sure! You're the one who suggested
we split up, after all.
dialog.translation:
¡Claro! Si eres el que propuso
dividirse, después de todo.

dialog.english: Then...
Go with Matt, T.K, and Mimi
dialog.translation: Ir con Matt, T.K. y Mimi

dialog.english: Go with Joe and Sora

I will go with Matt, Mimi, and
T.K.
dialog.translation: Iré con Matt, Mimi y T.K.

dialog.english: Okay, I'll go with Joe and Sora!
dialog.translation: ¡Vale, yo iré con Joe y Sora!

dialog.english: I will go with Joe and Sora.
Okay, I'll go with the others!
So it's decided, then.
Okay, we'll meet back up here.
Stay safe, everyone!
Leave this area to me!
Then, let's proceed.
Okay!
Izzy! Over here!

This room's door has a different
color. Let's take a look!
dialog.translation:
Esta sala es de color diferente.
¡Echemos un ojo!

dialog.english: All right!

It's a large battery and a motor!
Is this what powers the factory?
dialog.translation:
¡Una pila gigante y un motor!
¿Esto le da energía a la fábrica?

dialog.english: Wow...
Izzy!

It's a large battery and a motor!
Is this what powers the factory?
dialog.translation:
¡Una pila gigante y un motor!
¿Esto le da energía a la fábrica?

dialog.english: Wow...
Bonding Conversation Test
Bonding Conversation Test
Bonding Conversation Test
Bonding Conversation Test

Huh? There's a door in a place
like this?
dialog.translation:
¿Eh? ¿Hay una puerta en un sitio
así?

dialog.english: Prolly goes inside the battery.
I'll take a look.
Izzy, we'll come too.

It's okay. Tentomon and I can
investigate on our own.
dialog.translation:
Descuida. Tentomon y yo podemos
investigar.

dialog.english:
Okay, we'll wait here for you.
Tell us if you find something.
dialog.translation:
Vale, te esperamos aquí.
Avisa si encuentras algo.

dialog.english: I will!
Do you want us to come with you?

It's okay. Tentomon and I can
investigate on our own.
dialog.translation:
Descuida. Tentomon y yo podemos
investigar.

dialog.english:
We'll wait here, then, so tell us
when you're done.
dialog.translation:
Esperaremos aquí, pues, y nos
avisas cuando acabes.

dialog.english: I will!

Looks like Izzy and the
others left.
dialog.translation:
Parece que Izzy y los demás
se han ido.

dialog.english: Yeah. We should keep going, too.
Euuuuuugh...
A voice?
It's coming from this room.
Let's check it out.
I'm worried about this.
Over there!
A r-robot?
It's not a robot, it's Andromon!
So this is a Digimon, too?

Yeah, and he's a good Digimon. But
it looks like he can't move.
dialog.translation:
Sí, y un Digimon bueno.
Pero parece estar inmóvil.

dialog.english: Really? Then...
He'll move if we give him a whack!
dialog.translation: ¡Se moverá si le pego un galletazo!

dialog.english: He'll budge if we handle him gently.
dialog.translation: Se moverá al tratarlo con cuidado.

dialog.english: Keep watching for a little while.
Don't, Tai!

No, don't! If you whack him, he'll
break even more!
dialog.translation:
¡No, no! ¡Si le arreas, se romperá
aún más!

dialog.english: B-but...

Honestly! Don't you remember how
you almost broke Koushiro's
laptop?
dialog.translation:
¡En serio! ¿No te acuerdas de que
casi te cargas el portátil de
Izzy?

dialog.english: Can't you have a little prudence?
Yes, we should wake him up gently.

But what if he suddenly attacks as
soon as we wake him up?
dialog.translation:
¿Pero qué ocurre si nos ataca
según se despierte?

dialog.english: Why are you worrying so much, Joe?
I have a bad feeling about this.

Yeah! If we're reckless and bang
on him, we don't know what'll
happen!
dialog.translation:
¡Si no tenemos cuidado y lo
tratamos a tortas no sabemos qué
pasará!

dialog.english:
But how long are we gonna have to
stand around here?
Yeah, but...

Well, we'll keep watching for a
bit more.
Really?

Yeah, nothing's happening. Guess
just watching won't do anything.
dialog.translation:
Nada. 
Mirar no sirve de nada.

dialog.english: Okay, I'm gonna try hitting him!
dialog.translation: ¡Vale, le voy a dar un guantazo!

dialog.english: A-are you serious?
I'm worried about this.

Don't wake him up violently!
You'll scare him.
dialog.translation:
¡No lo despiertes a golpes!
Le asustarás.

dialog.english: Anyway, let's wake him up.
Are you sure about this?
It'll be fine. Okay, here goes!

Hey, Tai! How long are we going
to keep doing this?
Matt, don't get mad!

Yeah! I mean, I get the feeling of
not wanting to get up in the
morning.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, quiero decir, entiendo no
querer pegar el madrugón.

dialog.english:
Well, let's just keep watching for
a little longer.
Tai! Andromon started moving!
...DETECTED!

Oh! He talked! What does he mean
by "detected"?
INTRUDERS DETECTED!
Uwaaaaahh!

Agumon! Didn't you say he was a
good Digimon?!
dialog.translation:
¡Agumon! ¡Se supone que era un
Digimon bueno!

dialog.english: He's supposed to be!
Guys, ruuuuuun!!
This is...!!

What's this pattern on this side
of the walls?
dialog.translation:
¿Qué son estos símbolos de las
paredes?

dialog.english: It's a computer program.
Izzy, what'cha doing?

I'm trying to analyze this
program. At last, my computer gets
some use...
dialog.translation:
Intento analizar el programa. Por
fin mi ordenador sirve
para algo...

dialog.english:
Izzy, your face is full'a
life!
dialog.translation: Izzy. ¡Se te ve lleno de vida!

dialog.english:
It's because I can finally solve
some mysteries. Where we are now,
what you all are, etc.
dialog.translation:
Es porque por fin puedo
averiguar algo de lo que ocurre.
Dónde estamos, qué sois, etc.

dialog.english:
Huh. I'm not real interested in
that kinda thing.
dialog.translation:
Ahá. No me interesan mucho esas
cosas.

dialog.english: Really?

Hey Izzy, is there somethin'
'bout yourself that you're
interested in?
dialog.translation:
Eh Izzy, ¿hay algo sobre ti
en lo que estés realmente
interesado?

dialog.english:
Hey, dear. When are we going to
tell him the truth...?

A little longer. Let's wait a
little longer. If we tell
Izzy now, it'll shock him.
dialog.translation:
Aún no. Esperemos un poco más.
Si se lo decimos a Izzy, no sé
cómo se lo tomará.

dialog.english:
Hey, Izzy! Izzy, over
here!
W-what is it?

There's somethin' weird on ya
computer screen!
dialog.translation:
¡Hay algo extraño en la pantalla
del ordenador!

dialog.english:
The text on the screen is moving
on its own!
dialog.translation: ¡El texto se mueve por sí solo!

dialog.english:
The text on the screen is moving
on its own!
dialog.translation: ¡El texto se mueve por sí solo!

dialog.english: Izzy! The Digivice!
It's lighting up, too!

Atchaaah! Ow ow ow ow ow ow! Hey,
my whole body's burnin' up!
dialog.translation:
¡Ahh! ¡Au au au au au! ¡Eh!
¡Me quema todo el cuerpo!

dialog.english:
Tentomon! Are you okay?
Maybe it's because of this
program...?

How'd it go? Did you figure
anything out?

Yes! I'll tell you the details
later. For now, let's meet up
again with Tai.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Luego os cuento los detalles.
Por ahora, volvamos con Tai.

dialog.english:
We were worried! You didn't come
out for a while. Anyway, did you
find anything?
dialog.translation:
¡Nos preocupabas! Estuviste ahí
un buen rato. ¿Encontraste algo?

dialog.english:
Yes! I'll tell you the details
later. For now, let's meet up
again with Tai.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Os cuento luego los detalles.
Por ahora, volvamos con Tai.

dialog.english: Heeeeey! Izzy, everyone!
Tai!

Looks like everyone's doing just
fine!

More than fine! I've discovered
something amazing!
What'd you find, Izzy?

This factory is a program that
generates energy.
dialog.translation:
Esta fábrica es un programa que
genera energía.

dialog.english: So what does that mean?

Things like programs and data in
this world are not just
information.
dialog.translation:
Programas y datos en este mundo
son más que información.

dialog.english:
Digital data also manifests in a
concrete form.
dialog.translation:
Los datos digitales también
toman forma física.

dialog.english: ...? That's "something amazing"?

Tai! If we stay here and chat,
Andromon will catch us!
dialog.translation:
¡Tai! ¡Si nos quedamos aquí,
Andromon nos alcanzará!

dialog.english:
That's right! Right now, we've
gotta worry about Andromon!
dialog.translation:
¡Es verdad! ¡Ahora mismo hay que
preocuparse de Andromon!

dialog.english: Andromon?

We found a Digimon called Andromon
deep inside the factory, but...
dialog.translation:
Encontramos un Digimon llamado
Andromon en la fábrica, pero...

dialog.english: He suddenly attacked us!
Hurry up and get away from here!
Let's go!

Izzy! Andromon's coming from
that direction!

Is that so? Let's go the other
way.
dialog.translation: Ah, ¿sí? Vamos por el otro lado.

dialog.english: Darn it, he's chasing us again!
Let's hurry up and run!

T-this is bad! How are we gonna
escape from the roof?
dialog.translation:
¡Se pone feo! ¿Cómo vamos a escapar
por el tejado?

dialog.english:
It'll be all right. Let's turn
back for now.
INTRUDERS CAPTURED!
Uh-oh! He caught up to us!
In that case, it's our turn now!
Get back, everyone!
Spiral Sword!
Uwaaaah!
Gwaaah!

His power, speed, everything's a
level above our Digimon!
dialog.translation:
¡Es mucho más fuerte que nuestros
Digimon!

dialog.english: How are we supposed to win now?
Garurumon, hang in there!
You can do it, Greymon!
Izzy!

Is it okay if I try the program
from earlier?
dialog.translation:
¿Te importa si pruebo el programa
de antes?

dialog.english: Yeah!
All right...
Here it goes!
Whoaaaaa! I feel some kinda power!
Are you all right? Tentomon...!
It worked!
Tentomon evolved?!
Another black gear!
It disappeared!
The evil power is gone...

It seems that he's returned to his
normal self.
dialog.translation:
Parece haber vuelto a la
normalidad.

dialog.english:
I believe this happened because of
the black gear that entered my
body.
dialog.translation:
Parece que esto ocurrió porque
una rueda negra entró en mi
cuerpo.

dialog.english:
Don't worry about it. Guess it was
some kind of error.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes, sólo fue un
error.

dialog.english:
As my thanks for helping me, I
will tell you the way out. Leave 
through the underground sewers.
dialog.translation:
Como agradecimiento, os diré
cómo salir. Marchad por las
alcantarillas subterráneas.

dialog.english: Thanks, Andromon!

I wish you luck, and I hope that
you will be able to return to your
world.
dialog.translation:
Os deseo suerte. Espero que
podáis volver a vuestro mundo.

dialog.english:
Isn't this the entrance to the
underground sewers?
dialog.translation:
¿No es esa la entrada a las
alcantarillas?

dialog.english: Of course it is! Okay, let's go!
Hey, what's wrong, Izzy?!

T-this is...My computer's doing
things by itself!
dialog.translation:
Mi ordenador... está haciendo
cosas él solo.

dialog.english: Uwaah!
W-what's going on?
My body's being pulled away!
Everyone, grab onto something!
It's not working. Whoaaaaa!
Ugh, oof...uhhhhn...ah!
Guys! Where are you?
Tai!
Agumon! Guys!

Looks like everyone's here, and
doing just fine.
Where are we...?
I don't know.

At the very least, it doesn't look
like we've returned to our world.
dialog.translation:
Como mínimo, no parece que
estemos en nuestro mundo.

dialog.english: They're...!

Digimon! We seem to still be in
the Digimon world after all.
dialog.translation:
¡Digimon! Seguimos en el
mundo Digimon aún.

dialog.english:
There's something weird about
this...

We're completely lost for the
woods.

I don't wanna be trapped here for
the rest of my life!
dialog.translation:
¡No quiero estar aquí por el resto
de nuestras vidas!

dialog.english: Tai, over there!
A light! Maybe it's our way out!
Let's take a look!
W-we're back...

The sewer entrance! We did it! We
managed to escape!
What was that place, anyway?

It might be a place that comes
from this world's spatial
distortion.
dialog.translation:
Parecía una especie de distorsión
espacial de algún tipo.

dialog.english:
This world really has all kinds of
stuff.
dialog.translation:
En este mundo hay todo tipo de
rarezas.

dialog.english:
You know, I want to go back there
again sometime.
dialog.translation:
¿Sabes? Estaría bien poder volver
en algún momento.

dialog.english: Huh? Why?

There are Digimon opponents over
there. I think they'll be good for
training!
dialog.translation:
Había oponentes Digimon. Podría
ser un buen lugar de
entrenamiento.

dialog.english:
If we get stronger, we'll be able
to protect you guys!
I'll do my best to protect Sora!
Me too!

I wanna explore that place some
more!

Huh? Someone here's being a bit
trigger-happy.
What about you, Patamon?

I'm a little scared, but if I'm
with you, T.K, I'll be fine!
dialog.translation:
¡Me da algo de miedo, pero si
estoy contigo, T.K., estaré bien!

dialog.english:
Well, anyway, let's get back to
what we were doing and push on!
dialog.translation:
¡Sea como sea, volvamos a lo que
estábamos haciendo y sigamos!

dialog.english: What Tai said!

We'll discuss that other place
later.
Okay, let's go!

Sora, I wanna ask everyone about
where we should go after this.
dialog.translation:
Sora, quiero preguntarle al resto
dónde deberíamos ir después.

dialog.english:
Hey, Sora! I see a push cart over
there! Let's go play with it!
dialog.translation:
¡Eh Sora! Veo un carrito ahí.
¡Juguemos con él!

dialog.english: Hold on, Piyomon! Don't pull me!
Help her out
But I wanted to ask you...
Sora, I'll be Piyomon's playmate.

Don't worry about it! I'm the one
she wants to play with.
dialog.translation:
¡No te preocupes! Es conmigo con
quien quiere jugar.

dialog.english: Really?

But weirdly enough, it's starting
to get kind of cute.
Maybe it's...maternal instinct?

Maternal instinct? Maybe... but
I'm still in elementary school,
you know!
dialog.translation:
¿Maternal? ¡Quizás... pero si aún
estoy en primaria!

dialog.english: I-I'm sorry!
Haha, I'm joking.

Piyomon seems to be just a little
selfish...
dialog.translation:
Piyomon parece ser un poco
egoísta...

dialog.english:
She can't help it, she tends to
get lonely more easily than
others.
dialog.translation:
No lo puede evitar, tiende a
sentirse sola rápidamente.

dialog.english:
But if you keep coddling her like
this, it's only going to get
worse.
dialog.translation:
Pero si la sigues complaciendo
así, tan sólo irá a peor.

dialog.english:
Thanks for the concern. But it
hasn't become a huge problem yet,
has it?
dialog.translation:
Gracias por la preocupación, pero
no está siendo aún un problema,
¿no?

dialog.english:
Piyomon's very upfront about her
feelings.
dialog.translation:
Piyomon es directa con sus
sentimientos.

dialog.english: Can you watch TV on that computer?
dialog.translation: ¿Puedo ver la tele en ese PC?

dialog.english:
I don't have a TV tuner, and I
don't know how we'd get a signal.
dialog.translation:
No tengo antena, y no sé si
podría coger señal aquí.

dialog.english:
Then it can't do anything! It's
just an annoyance to the rest of
us.
dialog.translation:
¡Entonces no puede hacer nada!
Sólo es un estorbo para todos.

dialog.english: It can use the Internet!
You can use it to view databases.

You can obtain all kinds of
information from all over the
world.
dialog.translation:
Puedes obtener todo tipo de
información de todo el mundo.

dialog.english: So, can you do that here?
No. I can't do it here, but...
See?
You can view databases with it.
But what good does that do?

I can use the data I have here on
Digimon if there's ever an
emergency.
dialog.translation:
Puedo ver los datos de los
Digimon si algún día hay 
una emergencia.

dialog.english: Huh! That's pretty cool!

I don't really know much about
machines.

This place is bigger than I
thought and it's hard to find
anything. My muscles are all sore.
dialog.translation:
Este lugar es más grande de lo
que pensaba, es difícil encontrar
nada. Y tengo agujetas.

dialog.english: A bath would warm your muscles.
Me too.

You're right, but...I don't see
anything resembling a bath around
here.
dialog.translation:
Tienes razón, pero no hay nada
que parezca una bañera por aquí.

dialog.english: See, of course they would!
We've been walking all this way.

We got through a jungle, we got
through a desert...

We haven't slept in twelve hours.
It'd be great if we could find a
bed somewhere.
dialog.translation:
Llevamos doce horas sin dormir.
Estaría bien encontrar una cama
en algún lugar.

dialog.english:
Who on earth would make this
factory?
Perhaps Digimon...
Perhaps humans...

It may be Digimon. We have yet to
see any other humans.
dialog.translation:
Serían Digimon. 
No hemos visto aún ningún humano.

dialog.english:
That's true. It's pretty unlikely
that any other humans are here.
dialog.translation:
Cierto. Poco probable que haya más
humanos por aquí.

dialog.english:
Looks like we agree on that. I
thought I was the only one who
thought like this.
dialog.translation:
Parece que estamos de acuerdo.
Pensaba ser el único con esa
idea.

dialog.english:
It must be humans. It's similar to
the factories we're familiar with.
dialog.translation:
Tienen que ser humanos. Es muy
parecido a las fábricas humanas.

dialog.english:
But we haven't seen any humans
like us so far.
dialog.translation:
Pero no hemos visto a nadie como
nosotros aún.

dialog.english: That's true, but...

This factory has no one in it,
it's creepy...
dialog.translation:
Esta fábrica no aloja a nadie,
da mal rollo.

dialog.english:
You boys seem to like machines.
You don't ever seem to get tired
of it, do you?
dialog.translation:
Parece que os gustan las
máquinas. No parece que os
canséis de verlas, ¿no?

dialog.english: I suppose...

But you wouldn't get tired no 
matter how many clothes and 
accessories you looked at, right?
dialog.translation:
Pero no te cansarías de ver
mucha ropa y accesorios, ¿verdad?

dialog.english: Well, you have a point there!

Izzy, lemme borrow your
computer! I wanna play with it.
dialog.translation:
Izzy, ¡déjame el ordenador!
¡Quiero jugar con él!

dialog.english: I can't lend this computer to you!
Well, if it's just for a little...
Why...?

People have important things that
they can't let other people
borrow; for me, it's my computer.
dialog.translation:
La gente tiene cosas importantes
que prefiere no prestar. Para mí,
eso es este ordenador.

dialog.english:
For instance, if I asked you to
lend me Patamon, I think you would
refuse, too.
dialog.translation:
Por ejemplo, si te digo que me
prestases a Patamon, creo que te
negarías.

dialog.english:
You're right! I wouldn't lend you
Patamon.
Anyway, that's what I mean.
I understand, Izzy!

Yaaaay! Let me try pushing this!
Boop!

Ah! Please don't do that! Don't be
so reckless!

You don't want to me to have it
after all, do you, Izzy?

This is precision machinery, so if
you don't handle it carefully, I
can't let you borrow it.
dialog.translation:
Es un aparato delicado, si no lo
tratas bien, no puedo
prestártelo.

dialog.english: Oh, I see. I'm sorry, Izzy.

There are a lot of machines here,
but no toys.
dialog.translation:
Hay un montón de máquinas, pero
no juguetes.

dialog.english:
To be honest, I'm not sure if it's
a good idea to be splitting up
like this.
dialog.translation:
La verdad, no sé si es buena idea
el separarnos de este modo.

dialog.english: Answer confidently
Answer carefully

But with a factory of this size,
it's more efficient to split up.
dialog.translation:
Con una fábrica de este tamaño
es mejor que nos separemos.

dialog.english:
Izzy, you're starting to talk
like Tai. Are you starting to
take after him?
dialog.translation:
Izzy, empiezas a hablar como Tai.
¿Te estás convirtiendo en él?

dialog.english: Am I?

That may be true. There's
increased risk when we encounter
enemies.
dialog.translation:
Puede ser. Hay más riesgo
cuando topamos con enemigos.

dialog.english:
Ah, I'm sorry! I'm not trying to
blame you!

It's fine, it's a bad habit of
mine to constantly think about
maximizing efficiency.
dialog.translation:
Está bien, es una manía mía
pensar siempre en ser lo más
eficiente posible.

dialog.english:
But sometimes, that's a helpful
way to think.
dialog.translation:
Pero a veces es un modo útil
de pensar.

dialog.english: Thank you, Sora.

I wonder if Tai and the others
are okay.
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si Tai y el resto
están bien.

dialog.english:
Who do you think made this
factory?
Maybe Digimon?
Maybe humans?

It might be Digimon. We haven't
met any other humans.
dialog.translation:
Serían Digimon. No hemos visto
humanos aún.

dialog.english:
Really? How would Digimon make
this factory?
Well...

It surely must be humans. It's
very similar to the factories
we're familiar with.
dialog.translation:
Deben de ser humanos. Se parece
mucho a las fábricas de humanos.

dialog.english:
Of course! There should definitely
be humans here!
There's got to be humans here...!

Hm? Aren't Izzy and the
others checking out that area?
dialog.translation:
¿Hm? ¿No están Izzy y los demás
buscando ahí?

dialog.english:
Oops, we're supposed to check out
the other side.
dialog.translation:
¡Ups! Se supone que vamos por el
otro lado.

dialog.english: Hm? Are we going this way?

Oh, wait, we're supposed to look
at the right side.
dialog.translation:
Ah, no, tenemos que ir por el
lado derecho.

dialog.english: So, what'll we do from here?

Tai and the others have gone
ahead, so let's head back for now.
dialog.translation:
Tai y el resto ya se han ido, así
que volvamos por ahora.
